facts.fact: A citizen's open letter to the president, reported 2026-09-10, says internet connectivity in Chad's Lac province has been heavily limited for nearly two years on security grounds and was still limited at that date; the source does not name the body that ordered it and gives no end date. As_of is the report's published date.

note: The author is a private citizen, not a named paper, party or group, so no debate fact.
